description.value: Gage Apartments at UBC offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom self-contained suites with full kitchens on the University of British Columbia's forested Vancouver campus, available year-round to the general public. The property is carbon-neutral, with heating and hot water supplied by biomass generation and hydroelectricity, and select suites are pursuing LEED Gold Certification. A major bus exchange is located on campus, putting downtown Vancouver roughly 25 minutes away.
